tasks.subject: Task 1: C runtime — WokForeignBytes cell + C lifecycle test
tasks.description:
Fixed-24B WokForeignBytes C cell (tag 0xFFFB) holding a foreign pointer + length: wok_foreign_bytes_alloc/_ptr/_len, a wok_free arm before the arity fallback (24B class 2, never touches the foreign ptr), and an ASan-clean C lifecycle test + negative control (skip free -> LSan leak). Full code in the plan Task 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["runtime/wok_rc.h", "runtime/wok_rc.c", "runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c", "scripts/asan-runtime.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wok_foreign_bytes_alloc returns 24B 0xFFFB cell charging 24", "ptr/len accessors round-trip", "wok_free 0xFFFB arm before arity fallback recycles 24B class 2", "C lifecycle test ASan/LSan clean cur_bytes 24->0", "negative control leaks under LSan"], "modelTier": "standard", "planRef": "docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-28-ffi-bytes-in.md#task-1"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: RC interpreter — NForeignBytes node, adopt alloc, foreign-free drop
tasks.description:
NForeignBytes node (charges fixed 24B handle; nodeValues=[]; nodeCEligible=False; all -Werror matcher arms), wokForeignBytesTag=0xFFFB + internTag skip (0xFFFB first), allocForeignBytes (libc mallocBytes+copy+wok_foreign_bytes_alloc, charge 24), dropAddr arms (bytes=24; kids: read ptr, libc free, return []), bytesBytes/bytesViaDeref tag dispatch, + store-level unit test both backends. Full code in the plan Task 2.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Differential-oracle corpus, properties, zero-copy-saving pin
tasks.description:
test/rc-ffi-bytes/ corpus run through the 3-way differential oracle (output + stats + C-heap parity, mirroring rcBytesFiles), plus the property that adopt's peak_bytes == copy's - (wouldBeCBytes(NBytes pattern) - 24). Covers valid/invalid UTF-8, index/toList on adopted, eqBytes across copy/adopt/fromList. Full detail in the plan Task 4.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/rc-ffi-bytes", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"rc ffi bytes\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["corpus identical output on 3 backends", "peak_bytes abstract==CHeap per program", "adopt saves exactly wouldBeCBytes(n)-24 vs copy on both RC backends", "corpus covers valid/invalid/index/toList/eq"], "modelTier": "standard", "planRef": "docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-28-ffi-bytes-in.md#task-4"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Soundness — leak/double-free death test + region-escape adversarial
tasks.description:
Dup-then-drop balance (buffer freed exactly once, no double-free, baseline restored), region-escape adversarial (adopted Bytes escaping its activation stays counted-Heap not arena; Region.isStringType TcBytes=True), corpus leak-balance sweep (live==0 both RC backends). Review test soundness hardest at the whole-branch Opus deep review. Full detail in the plan Task 5.
